title: Gate de dead-code para locals/params nao-usados (noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters ou biome noUnusedVariables)
description: Classe F-05 exposta no CAM-133: tsconfig tem noUnusedLocals:false e noUnusedParameters:false, e knip.json exclui exports/types/duplicates, entao locals e params orfaos escapam de TODO gate estatico (typecheck, knip). No CAM-133 isso fez o cutover deixar dead code residual (const writeFile orfao, import writeFileSync morto, destructure branchWasMain nao-usado) que NENHUM gate pegou: o reviewer teve que caca-los manualmente em 3 rounds (round 1 e 2 ambos sobre dead code residual do cutover). Proposta: habilitar noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters:true no tsconfig OU adicionar a regra biome noUnusedVariables como error, pra dead code de local/param ser pego na Layer A (implementer) em vez de gastar rounds de review. Avaliar o blast radius (quantos locals/params orfaos pre-existentes precisariam ser limpos primeiro / grandfathered).

acceptanceCriteria: tsconfig.json sets noUnusedLocals: true AND noUnusedParameters: true.
bunx tsc --noEmit exits 0 with the flags enabled (all 68 pre-existing violations cleaned: 31 unused locals + 27 unused params + 10 unused types).
The diff introduces NO new @ts-ignore or @ts-expect-error directives to suppress unused locals/params (cleanup is real, not blanket suppression).
bun run check:all passes green (full 12-gate spine; typecheck is gate #1).

Unused parameters that are part of a required signature (callback / interface impl / override) are underscore-prefixed, not deleted in a way that alters the signature; behaviour preserved (tests green).
spec.scope: Enable noUnusedLocals and noUnusedParameters in the root tsconfig.json and clean the 68 resulting violations (~60 in test/**, only 5 in src/). Scope is strictly these two flags plus the cleanup. Do NOT touch noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature (stays false), do NOT configure biome noUnusedVariables, do NOT touch knip.json. No new check:all gate is added: the stricter typecheck rides existing gate #1, so the gate-count freeze (12) and validate-agents-md are untouched.
gotchas: Local flagged unused whose RHS has a side effect: drop only the dead binding, not the expression. E.g. `const x = await setup()` with x unread becomes `await setup()`, not deleted.
The leading-underscore escape suppresses only PARAMETERS in tsc, never LOCALS. A dead local must be genuinely removed; renaming it to _x does not satisfy noUnusedLocals.

Param in a required signature -> underscore-prefix; removable param -> remove. Deleting a required callback/override param does NOT fail tsc (fewer params stays assignable) but silently breaks the contract; the reviewer + tests guard this.
biome noUnusedVariables was rejected because biome.json excludes test/**, so it would miss ~88% of these violations; tsc is chosen precisely because typecheck already covers test/**.
noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature sits next to the two target flags in tsconfig but is a different rigor class (index-signature access) and is explicitly out of scope.
